key_insight: CutBackdoor shows that a VQA backdoor can stay hidden on the full circuit while only activating when the victim uses circuit cutting, making the deployment-time trigger the resource mismatch itself.
engineering_relevance: This exposes circuit cutting and public parameter sharing as a new supply-chain attack surface for practical quantum workflows on near-term hardware.
method: Poison pre-trained VQA parameters, not the circuit structure
Exploit CutQC-style circuit cutting as the trigger path
Preserve normal full-circuit accuracy while degrading cut-path reconstruction
evidence_signal: Across multiple VQA benchmarks and IBM backends, the attack produced 1.3x to 2.9x cut-path energy amplification while keeping stealthiness small on the full-circuit path.
watch_item: The attack depends on finite-shot cut execution and qubit-capacity mismatch, so defenses must consider when and where circuit cutting is invoked.
paper_title: CutBackdoor: A Circuit Cut Triggered Backdoor Attack on Variational Quantum Algorithms
